description: Compute Wilber's interleave lower bound for a supplied static BST and access sequence.

source.title: O(log log n)-Competitive Binary Search Tree
source.algorithm_attribution: Wilber's interleave lower bound over a static reference BST.
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded exact metric; Tango-tree construction is not covered

input.encoding: [node_count, root, (left_child, right_child) for each key rank, access_count, access_keys...]

workspace.meaning: Fixed child/parent arrays, visited flags, subtree masks, and staged scalar output.

contract.keys: Nodes are keys 0..n-1; left and right child indices are -1 or a valid node index.
contract.tree_validity: The root has no parent, every other node has exactly one parent, all nodes are reachable once, and each left/right subtree obeys strict BST key order.
contract.subtree_membership: An access belongs to pivot y's subtree when its key is y or a descendant of y.
contract.side_label: An access is labeled left when key <= pivot and right when key > pivot.
contract.interleave_bound: For each pivot, count side-label changes in the access sequence after filtering to that pivot's subtree; sum all pivot counts.
contract.error_results: Malformed input returns -1. Null output or capacity below 8 bytes returns -2 without writes.

oracle_method: The primary oracle builds subtree key masks and filters accesses per pivot. The independent verifier checks ancestry by following parent links from each access key.
